categories.main_business_segments: SentinelOne operates as a single reportable segment focused on cybersecurity solutions, primarily through its Singularity Platform. The platform delivers AI-powered threat prevention, detection, response, and exposure management across endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity credentials. The company also offers managed detection and response (MDR) services, threat intelligence, and strategic advisory services through recent acquisitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The core technology is the Singularity Platform, which leverages proprietary AI and machine learning models (Static AI, Behavioral AI, Streaming AI) for autonomous cybersecurity. The platform ingests, correlates, and analyzes petabytes of structured and unstructured data in real time, using a unified security data lake. Key innovations include Storyline technology for behavioral analysis, generative AI (Purple AI) for threat hunting and automation, and a multi-tenancy cloud architecture supporting deployment across public, private, and hybrid clouds.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SentinelOne serves over 14,000 direct customers globally, including large enterprises, small and medium-sized businesses, and government organizations. Key customer segments include Fortune 500 companies, managed security service providers (MSSPs), managed detection and response providers (MDRs), and incident response firms. The platform is used across diverse industries such as financial services, healthcare, government, and technology.
categories.geographic_coverage: SentinelOne operates in approximately 90 countries, with 37% of fiscal 2025 revenue generated outside the U.S. Major regions include North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The company maintains offices and R&D centers in the U.S., Israel, Czech Republic, Netherlands, India, and UAE, supporting a global workforce and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: SentinelOne operates downstream in the cybersecurity supply chain, providing end-user software and services directly to organizations and through channel partners. The company does not manufacture hardware but delivers cloud-based and on-premise software solutions, integrating with other security tools and platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in AI-driven autonomous cybersecurity, expanding platform capabilities (especially in cloud and identity security), and enhancing data analytics. R&D is focused on developing new modules, integrating generative AI (Purple AI), and extending coverage to new attack surfaces such as IoT and cloud-native applications. The company also pursues growth through acquisitions, international expansion, and deepening relationships with channel and technology partners.
categories.revenue_model: SentinelOne primarily generates revenue through subscription-based sales of its Singularity Platform and additional modules, priced on a per-agent basis (endpoint, server, VM, or container). Contracts typically range from one to three years, with revenue recognized ratably over the contract term. Additional revenue streams include managed detection and response services, premium support, and professional services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include CrowdStrike, Carbon Black (Broadcom), Trellix, Symantec (Broadcom), Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco (Splunk), Elastic, and Wiz. SentinelOne differentiates itself through its autonomous, AI-powered platform, breadth of functionality, and multi-cloud/multi-OS support. While some competitors have greater brand recognition and broader portfolios, SentinelOne is recognized as a leader in independent evaluations and is positioned as an innovator in autonomous cybersecurity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2025, SentinelOne reported $821.5 million in revenue, up 32% year-over-year, with an annualized recurring revenue (ARR) of $920.1 million. The company continues to operate at a net loss ($288.4 million in fiscal 2025), but has demonstrated rapid growth in both revenue and customer base. Cash, cash equivalents, and investments totaled $1.1 billion as of January 31, 2025, supporting ongoing investment in growth and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SentinelOne's value proposition centers on delivering autonomous, AI-driven cybersecurity that provides real-time, machine-speed protection and remediation across endpoints, cloud, and identities. Differentiators include its unified data lake, advanced AI models, Storyline behavioral analysis, generative AI for threat hunting, and flexible deployment options. The platform enables organizations to consolidate security tools, improve outcomes with fewer personnel, and achieve superior protection, visibility, and automation compared to legacy and first-generation solutions.
